A deliberately SMALL number and the useful part of it: CONCOR's dominant cost is 'Terminal and other service charges' 6,172.33, most of which is rail haulage paid to Indian Railways at administered rates rather than a diesel-indexed price. Read this row as evidence that CONCOR is NOT materially crude-exposed on the cost side, not as an incomplete measurement of a large exposure.
